title: Interactive customer escalation bridge, staffing rotations and live-patch pathways for mixed-deployment regressions
creator: Anika Patel
description: Runbook and operational coordination ticket to establish an interactive escalation bridge for customer-facing model rollout regressions affecting Hosted, Dedicated and Private deployments. Scope covers staffing rotations during incidents, templated customer comms, live-patch validation pathways (canary -> partial rollback -> patch -> staged rollforward), KV-cache reconciliation guidance, tenant-pin procedures and cross-env artifact promotion for emergency PRs.
acceptance_criteria: A documented incident bridge runbook exists that can be executed within 30 minutes of a customer escalation
Staffing rotation templates and on-call handoff checklist published and validated with SRE and Support
KV cache resync checklist and tenant-pin procedure verified in a dry-run against a staging slice
Communication templates (initial, interim, resolution) for Hosted/Dedicated/Private customers are approved by PM and Support
A set of validation queries and synthetic traffic gating scripts are checked into infra repo and runnable by responders
runbook_steps: Open incident bridge: create #incident-redwood-<id> channel and invite SRE, PM, Support, Solutions Eng, and Customer Success
Triage traffic: use console->routes dashboard to identify affected model variant, deployment mode and tenant slices
Snapshot state: capture current model pin/version, KV cache metadata, and active request traces to the incident ticket
Canary containment: if a canary subset failing, immediately isolate canary slice and divert new canary traffic to fallback variant
Partial rollback: prepare candidate model version for rollback, validate on synthetic slice, and apply staged rollback to 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic health gates
Live-patch path: if rollback not viable, coordinate expedited PR with runtime and model-onboarding owners, prepare hotpatch build, run cross-env validation then promote to affected zone
KV reconciliation: run kvcache-replay for affected tenants following validated window; ensure idempotent keys and check for staleness tokens
Tenant pinning: for Dedicated/Private customers, apply tenant pin to stable variant and confirm via per-tenant telemetry
Customer comms: send initial acknowledgement within 15 minutes; provide hourly updates and a postmortem timeline within SLA window
Post-fix validation: run regression eval suite on representative prompts and monitor SLOs for 72 hours before closing bridge
